def _parse_list_item(block: 'BlockParser', bullet: str, groups: Tuple[str,
    str, str], token: Dict[str, Any], state: 'BlockState', rules: List[str]
    ) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    leading_width, marker, text = groups
    leading_width = len(leading_width)
    
    # Get the initial text and continue width
    text, continue_width = _compile_continue_width(text, leading_width)
    
    # Collect all lines for this list item
    item_lines = [text] if text else []
    
    # Pattern to match a new list item at the same or lower indentation
    pattern = _compile_list_item_pattern(bullet, leading_width)
    list_item_pattern = re.compile(pattern, re.M)
    
    # Look ahead to find continuation lines and next item
    next_groups = None
    blank_lines = 0
    
    while state.cursor < len(state.src):
        line_end = state.src.find('\n', state.cursor)
        if line_end == -1:
            line_end = len(state.src)
        
        line = state.src[state.cursor:line_end]
        
        # Check for blank line
        if not line.strip():
            blank_lines += 1
            item_lines.append('')
            state.cursor = line_end + 1
            if blank_lines > 0:
                token['tight'] = False
            continue
        
        # Check if this is a new list item
        m_next = list_item_pattern.match(line)
        if m_next:
            next_groups = (m_next.group('listitem_1'), m_next.group('listitem_2'), m_next.group('listitem_3'))
            break
        
        # Check if line continues the list item (indented enough)
        if line.startswith(' ' * continue_width):
            blank_lines = 0
            item_lines.append(line[continue_width:])
            state.cursor = line_end + 1
        elif continue_width == 1 and line and not line[0].isspace():
            # Special case: continue_width of 1 means any non-blank line continues
            blank_lines = 0
            item_lines.append(line)
            state.cursor = line_end + 1
        else:
            # Line doesn't continue this item
            break
    
    # Clean up the collected text
    item_text = '\n'.join(item_lines)
    item_text = _clean_list_item_text(item_text, continue_width)
    
    # Parse the list item content
    list_item: Dict[str, Any] = {
        'type': 'list_item',
        'children': [],
    }
    
    # Create a new state for parsing list item content
    child_state = state.copy()
    child_state.process(item_text)
    
    # Parse children with the specified rules
    block.parse(child_state, rules)
    list_item['children'] = child_state.tokens
    
    # Check if this creates a loose list
    if _is_loose_list(list_item['children']):
        token['tight'] = False
    
    token['children'].append(list_item)
    
    # Return the next list item groups if found
    return next_groups
